मृज् (ऊ) मृजू r. 2nd cl. (मार्ष्टि) r. 1st and 10th cls. (मार्जति मार्जयति-ते)
 1.
To clean, to cleanse.
 2. To be clean or pure.
 3. To ornament.
 4.
To sound.
 5. To sharpen. With अप or प्र prefixed, 1. To sweep, to
sweep away.
 2. To clean. With सम 1. To clean.
 2. To stroke.
 3.
To filter.

मृज m. (-जः) A musical instrument, probably a sort of tabor or drum.
f. (-जा)
 1. Cleaning the body, by washing, anointing, &c.
 2.
Purification, ablution.
 3. Complexion.
 E. मृज् to cleanse, to sound
aff. क, or अङ्, and टाप् aff.

मृजान्वय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Clean, cleansed.
 E. मृजा, and अन्वय order.
मृजित f. (-ता) Adj. Wiped away, removed.

मृज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be cleaned or purified.
 E. मृज् to cleanse,
क्यप् aff.; also मार्ग्य ।
